# The Persistent Widow Revisited (Luke 18:7)

## Emotional Focus
Never stopping when we talk to our good Father.

## Key KJV
“Shall not God avenge his own elect, which cry day and night unto him?” (Luke 18:7)

## Gentle Retelling
Jesus told the story of the widow who kept asking. He said our Heavenly Father is even kinder — He loves when we keep coming to Him.

## Coloring Prompt
The widow gently knocking again with hope on her face.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“Our Father in heaven is glad when we keep talking to Him.”
